label: Giovanni Francesco Rustici
summary: Florentine sculptor, author of the bronze group of St John the Baptist preaching above the north door of the Baptistery (1506 to 1511).

claims.statement: Died in France, at Tours, about 1554.

claims.statement: The Arte di Calimala commissioned the group in December 1506; it was installed above the north door in 1511 and is now in the Museo dell'Opera del Duomo.

value.text: Leonardo's involvement in the Baptistery group and shared lodging, 1507 to 1508

claims.statement: Vasari states that Leonardo advised Rustici on the Baptistery bronzes and that Leonardo lodged with him in the house of Piero Martelli. The extent of collaboration is uncertain.
